nom: COSRX Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report mixed results, with some describing breakouts and clogged pores while others (including one long-term user with oily skin who tried many products) call it the best product for calming oily, angry skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, very dry, or eczema-prone skin generally report strong hydration, softer skin, and disappearance of dry flaking patches, with one exception of a dry-skinned reviewer who developed temporary under-skin texture/bumps.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are split: several describe it as vibrant, bouncy, and hydrating with no issues, while others report breakouts, clogged pores on the nose, or a preference to avoid it under makeup due to pilling or sliding.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers (including eczema-prone and allergy-prone users) mostly report no irritation, no breakouts, and a calming effect, though one sensitive-combination reviewer noted burning sensation and small breakouts.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin who never breaks out reports repeated breakouts specifically tied to this product.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (40s-60s) report firmer, plumper skin and reduced fine lines, with one long-term user in her 50s calling it fantastic for her skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on aging report firmer, plumper skin and reduced appearance of fine lines and wrinkles with regular use over weeks to months; no dissent noted on this concern specifically.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report significant, lasting hydration and plumpness, including in winter and dry climates; one 2/5 review concluded it mainly benefits hydration and offers little else for oily/combination skin.
concerns.redness: Reviewers mention reduced redness and calming of rosacea-prone or reactive skin, with no dissenting reports of increased redness found in this set.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers describe it as restoring a damaged skin barrier after harsh products (e.g., a cleanser mishap) and strengthening skin overall; no negative barrier reports appear.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report reduced acne scarring, dark spots, and hyperpigmentation with consistent use over months; no dissent noted on this concern.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers with acne-prone skin report fewer breakouts, faster healing of blemishes, and reduced cystic acne over weeks to months; however, several reviewers (including normal, oily, and combination skin) report the opposite — new breakouts, cystic pimples, or worsened acne, some framing it as unusual for their skin.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers with oily skin report it is lightweight, non-greasy, and helps balance oiliness without heaviness; one reviewer notes it does not cause breakouts despite a lifelong oily skin history.

aspects.libelle: Layers well with other skincare steps

extraits.titre: Be careful using this product with oily skin or combination
extraits.texte: I had seen so many fantastic reviews about this everywhere so I figured I'd give it a try. I began slowly incorporating it into my routine until I was using it in the am and pm. I did my research to figure out the right way to apply it on my skin. It never irritated my skin, but it made me break out in areas that I never normally get acne. At first I thought it was the purging process so I continued to keep using it, but as it worsened my skin, I finally decided to give up on the product after using it daily for an entire month. Finally after two weeks not using the product anymore, my skin is starting to look much better and the break outs are decreasing. I am still dealing with a massive cystic pimple on my inner cheek, the biggest and most painful one I've ever had. Again, not a normal area for me to get acne. I wish I hadn't tired the product in the first place as I feel I have only taken steps backwards on my skin care journey. I unfortunately would not recommend using this product if you have oil or combination skin. It may clog your pores and do more harm than good.

This product is truly beyond fabulous in every way! Snail mucin is like eternal youth in a bottle. Plus, there is absolutely no scent to this product. It has a silky seem texture with a bit of slick tackiness to it, but it doesn't stay tacky on the skin after application. The best way to apply this product is to press pat it in to the skin. It does sink onto the skin and give off this glass like finish that I absolutely love. I apply sunscreen over it during the day and I apply moisturizer over it after applying it at night. It gives a slight tingle after application due to just how potent of a product it is. Which is why. A little bit does go a long way with this product. I have very sensitive, dry-to-sometimes very dry, eczema prone skin. I very rarely breakout at this time. I have gone through recent changes in my skincare regimen and most of the products that I recently switched over to now using both day and night on my skin are K Beauty products. They make a HUGE difference, from the jump. I noticed a beautifully radiant glow to my skin and just a brighter, plumper, more healthier look to my complexion after the very 1st time I ever used this product. It doesn't break me out, it is perfect for use throughout all seasons. It just gives off such a wonderfully radiant, truly revitalized look to one's skin that's like a true kiss 😘 from HEAVEN 🤍

I am an esthetician and have access to the highest quality of skincare but I always find myself keeping this as my number one product. I have oily and sensitive skin so everything I used before this has made my face angry. This absorbs into the skin beautifully.

extraits.titre: Saved my skin in a week
extraits.texte: This product is my holy grail. It took my extremely dry acne prone skin, to moisturized clear skin. I had 8/10 acne. Now after using this snail mucin, my acne is a 2/10. Thank you for saving my skin Cosrx!

Im on heavy retinol which leaves my oily combo skin dry and flakey but if i use a heavy cream moisturizer Im almost guaranteed to get milia (small hard white bumps, not whiteheads) which drive me nuts. I love this since it prevents milia and dries quickly if you want to layer on top. Its super hydrating without being greasy. No fragrance but leaves my skin so soft. 10/10 even better during 21 days of beauty for 50% off
This is a great product. My first ever snail mucin product. It is so hydrating. I wake up with such dewy skin. It does not bother my rosacea. One tip, pat this on damp skin. You'll love it!

I'm completely underwhelmed by this miracle product. I've been using this 2x daily for 2 months and am halfway through the bottle. I haven't experienced any of the claims like smoother skin, less irritation, etc. I have sensitive combination skin, and since adding this to my routine, I've had small breakouts on my chin and the pores on my nose are more clogged; I've had to start using nose strips which I stopped a few years ago. The mucin irritated my skin initially; after the first 2 weeks, I started to notice a slight burning sensation when applying products to my face, just like when I first started using retinol. After doing more research and looking at Cosrx's own website, I'm convinced the main benefit of this is hydration and everything else is just marketing. I think users with dry skin will benefit, but since I have oily/combination skin, it doesn't help me. I also live in a hot and humid place. I might give this a second shot in the winter to see if my skin feels better, but for now, I don't plan to re buy.
